claims.statement: Sheriff Jessie Coomes of Lincoln County, Mo., came to St. Louis seeking the arrest of Tom Allen and others on charges of prize fighting and abetting a fight.
claims.excerpt: men, viz.: Tom Kelly, Ed Kelly, Tom Allen,

claims.statement: Tom Allen was a second or trainer at a prize fight in Lincoln County, Mo., about 1887, in which Dan Daly defeated Ed Kelly.
claims.excerpt:
The principals in the fight were Ed Keily
and Dan Daly, while the others were
seconds and trainers.

claims.statement: The sheriff's arrest papers for Tom Allen and the others appeared to be defective, so he returned to Troy to have them perfected.

notes: The article is a request for arrests, not an arrest. Allen was a second or trainer, not a fighter, so no fight entry. The 1887 date is from 'two years ago' and is approximate. Dan Daly and Ed Kelly are the fighters; Ed Keily is printed in the OCR for Ed Kelly.
